CHANGE means the user clearly describes a change between old and new state; CORRECTION means the user explicitly corrects a prior statement. If the pair differs but the text does not establish a change, use CONFLICT or UNCERTAIN. Two careers, hobbies or relationships can coexist; never assume single-valued. A simple "I live in Beijing" then "I live in Shanghai" alone does not establish correction. If a quotation or identity cannot be established, explain uncertainty.
